data.narrative:
EraDive operates in the Space & Aerospace sector, a space with 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs. The target's stage remains undisclosed, limiting precision in peer selection.

Two standard valuation methods proved inapplicable. Peer-Median triangulation failed due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables: while 14 same-sector peers exist in our database, none of the filtered subsets (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) yielded the minimum 3 datapoints required for statistical reliability. Widening to all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable sector heterogeneity. Public-Comp Anchoring could not proceed because the target's revenue remains undisclosed—standard for private companies—preventing application of the sector's median P/S multiple of 27.4x across six public tickers.

Without revenue disclosure or sufficient staged peer datapoints, no triangulated valuation range can be derived from the available data. Proceeding with analysis would require either: disclosure of the target's revenue, clarification of development stage to enable narrow-peer filtering, or access to transaction multiples within the narrow comparable set. The public sector median P/S of 27.4x provides a distant ceiling but cannot anchor a defensible private valuation absent revenue or margin clarity.
